'''Kattada''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Commenor Run/Legends|Commenor Run]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Description==
[[File:Kattada.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Haleoda]]'s [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].]]
The planet was a terrestrial planet with a tropical climate. It was well known for its beautiful beaches. The city of [[Haleoda]] was the capital and the planet's main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Princess-Warrior" />

==History==
Kattada joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:TantiveIVLeavesKattada-SWEmp6.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''Tantive IV'' departs Kattada]]</div>
Prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the planet was ruled by [[Mia Ikova]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer. It was the site of the [[Battle of Kattada]], which was a battle fought between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and Rebellion forces led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Princess-Warrior" />
